name: Fique de Pé
summary: Fique de Pé is a 3D multiplayer quiz game styled as a Brazilian TV game show, played in the web browser. Up to twelve contestants stand on a round stage, each one over a trapdoor, and take turns answering trivia questions against the clock while a host and a cheering studio audience follow every move. A wrong answer or a run-out timer opens the floor and the contestant drops out of the show, and the last one standing takes the prize. Besides the classic mode, players can face off in one-on-one duels or team up in pairs, and streamers can bring their own Twitch chat into the studio as the audience.
